reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Drop Support for Log Config, Add Log Paths (#6586) #6586 (Reed Schalo)", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: setting-ignored

consequence.statement: Environments that rely on Log Config will have that log configuration no longer honoured after upgrading to v1.0.0; log output configuration must be moved to the newly added Log Paths mechanism.
consequence.remediation: Replace Log Config configuration with the new Log Paths mechanism introduced in #6586.

proposed.statement: The v1.0.0 release notes state that Karpenter drops support for Log Config (it is no longer honoured) and adds Log Paths (PR #6586).
